turns.question: what is java
turns.answer: Java is an operating system-independent, processor-independent, object-oriented programming language that has become the leading interactive environment for the Web, designed to run on any computer or computing device regardless of the specific microprocessor or operating system the device uses, and is the most popular development platform for mobile devices running the Android operating system [1].
